UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile for A.O.Jarvis cloud sync.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

CloudMemory.title: CloudMemory
CloudMemory.description: Durable user memory synced to Firestore for A.O.Jarvis context.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the memory owner.

key.description: Short title or topic key for the memory.

content.description: Detailed memory text remembered by the assistant.

CloudVoiceCommand.title: CloudVoiceCommand
CloudVoiceCommand.description: Custom user voice command routine synced to Firestore.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the command owner.

triggerPhrase.description: Voice trigger phrase that activates this routine.

actionType.description: Execution mode for the voice command.

actionPayload.description: Response text, webhook URL, or agent prompt payload.

enabled.description: Whether the voice command is currently enabled.

CloudSession.title: CloudSession
CloudSession.description: Synced metadata for an A.O.Jarvis conversation session.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the session owner.

title.description: Display title of the conversation session.

lastMessagePreview.description: Optional preview snippet of the latest message.

messageCount.description: Total number of messages in the session.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document isolated per authenticated UID.

/users/{userId}/memories/{memoryId}.description: User-scoped long-term memories synced across devices.

/users/{userId}/voice_commands/{commandI.description: User-scoped custom voice commands synced across devices.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: User-scoped conversation session metadata synced across devices.
